journey.proof: Record contract defines external ID, CIF location, property, unit and calculation context.
Illustrative source structure is bundled locally so the demo does not depend on network retrieval.
Expected immutable raw payload plus deterministic checksum and ingestion_batch linkage.
Gemmi parsing and stable validation codes should create a valid version or quarantine the raw record.
Formula/atom count/volume/density may be derived when defensible; imported band gap retains method context.
Observation should trace to calculation/derivation context, structure version, raw record, release, source and batch.
Older scientific evidence is retained rather than overwritten.
Researcher can inspect structures, observations, failures and lineage locally.
A clean user should be able to reproduce the local demo and understand where the property came from.

failure_injections.name: Raw mutation after ingest
failure_injections.mutation: Change one byte in the preserved raw payload after checksum capture.
failure_injections.expected_gate: checksum/fixity or immutability control rejects/detects the change.
failure_injections.minimum_test: Attempted update of raw_source_record must fail or be prevented by the persistence contract.

failure_injections.name: Malformed CIF
failure_injections.mutation: Use the bundled malformed CIF record.
failure_injections.expected_gate: CIF_PARSE_FAILED is recorded; raw evidence remains; no false successful structure version is published.
failure_injections.minimum_test: Integration test asserts preserved raw + fatal issue + quarantine.

failure_injections.name: Incomplete DFT context
failure_injections.mutation: Import band gap with missing method context fields.
failure_injections.expected_gate: Observation remains traceable but the missing context is explicit; no invented values.
failure_injections.minimum_test: Quality/validation status exposes incompleteness without fabricating parameters.

failure_injections.name: Broken lineage link
failure_injections.mutation: Remove or omit the relationship needed to reach source/release.
failure_injections.minimum_test: GET /lineage/observations/{id} cannot pass the complete-chain assertion.

failure_injections.name: Duplicate re-ingestion
failure_injections.mutation: Run the identical bundled ingestion a second time.
failure_injections.expected_gate: No duplicate source/release/raw/structure/observation is created for the same identity/method version.
failure_injections.minimum_test: Second run succeeds and reports reused/skipped counts.
